help_admins: 𓆩 🌸 ᴀᴅᴍɪɴ • ᴄᴏᴍᴍᴀɴᴅs 𓆪 /pause: Pause the lovely music. /resume: Resume our musical journey. /skip: Skip to the next beautiful song. /stop: End the current stream. /seek [seconds]: Jump forward in the song. /seekback [seconds]: Jump backward in the song. /reload: Refresh my admin memory!
help_auth: 𓆩 🌸 ᴀᴜᴛʜ • ᴄᴏᴍᴍᴀɴᴅs 𓆪 Authorized users are special friends who can control the music even without being admins! /auth: Add a new special friend to the list. /unauth: Remove someone from the special list.
